   897→// getStagedFiles returns a list of files staged for commit.
   898→func getStagedFiles(repo *git.Repository) []string {
   899→	worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
   900→	if err != nil {
   901→		return nil
   902→	}
   903→
   904→	status, err := worktree.Status()
   905→	if err != nil {
   906→		return nil
   907→	}
   908→
   909→	var staged []string

   911→		// Check if file is staged (in index)
   912→		if fileStatus.Staging != git.Unmodified && fileStatus.Staging != git.Untracked {
   913→			staged = append(staged, path)
   914→		}
   915→	}
   916→	return staged
   917→}

   931→	sessionData, err := s.extractSessionData(repo, ref.Hash(), state.SessionID, nil, state.AgentType)
   932→	if err != nil || len(sessionData.Prompts) == 0 {
   933→		return ""
   934→	}
   935→
   936→	// Return the last prompt (most recent work before commit)
   937→	return sessionData.Prompts[len(sessionData.Prompts)-1]

   951→	}

   358→// calculatePromptAttributionForSave calculates attribution at checkpoint save time.
   359→// This detects user edits since the last checkpoint for files the agent is NOT touching.
   360→//
   361→// The key insight: at SaveChanges time, the worktree contains agent's changes mixed with
   362→// any user edits. We separate them by:
   363→// 1. Files in ctx.ModifiedFiles/NewFiles/DeletedFiles = agent is touching these
   364→// 2. Other files that changed since last checkpoint = user edits between prompts
   365→//
   366→// For files the agent IS touching, we can't distinguish user edits made before the agent
   367→// worked (the worktree has both mixed). Those will be detected by the final attribution
   368→// at commit time (shadow → committed diff).
   369→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) calculatePromptAttributionForSave(
   370→	repo *git.Repository,
   371→	state *SessionState,
   372→	ctx SaveContext,
   373→) PromptAttribution {
   374→	nextCheckpointNum := state.CheckpointCount + 1
   375→

err == nil {\n\t\tif tree, treeErr := baseCommit.Tree(); treeErr == nil {\n\t\t\tbaseTree = tree\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tworktree, err := repo.Worktree()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn result\n\t}\n\n\t// Get worktree status to find ALL changed files\n\tstatus, err := worktree.Status()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn result\n\t}\n\n\tworktreeRoot := worktree.Filesystem.Root()\n\n\t// Build map of changed files with their current worktree content\n\tchangedFiles := make(map[string]string)\n\tfor filePath, fileStatus := range status {\n\t\t// Skip unmodified files\n\t\tif fileStatus.Worktree == git.Unmodified && fileStatus.Staging == git.Unmodified {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Skip .entire metadata directory (session data, not user code)\n\t\tif strings.HasPrefix(filePath, paths.EntireMetadataDir+\"/\") || strings.HasPrefix(filePath, \".entire/\") {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Read current worktree content\n\t\tfullPath := filepath.Join(worktreeRoot, filePath)\n\t\tcontent, err := os.ReadFile(fullPath) //nolint:gosec // filePath is from git worktree status\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tchangedFiles[filePath] = \"\" // File deleted or unreadable\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tchangedFiles[filePath] = string(content)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Use CalculatePromptAttribution from manual_commit_attribution.go\n\tresult = CalculatePromptAttribution(baseTree, lastCheckpointTree, changedFiles, nextCheckpointNum)\n\n\treturn result\n}\n\n// getStagedFiles returns a list of files staged for commit."

   270→// This captures user edits since the last checkpoint BEFORE the agent makes changes.
   271→//
   272→// Parameters:
   273→//   - baseTree: the tree at session start (the base commit)
   274→//   - lastCheckpointTree: the tree from the previous checkpoint (nil if first checkpoint)
   275→//   - worktreeFiles: map of file path → current worktree content for files that changed
   276→//   - checkpointNumber: which checkpoint we're about to create (1-indexed)
   277→//
   278→// Returns the attribution data to store in session state.
   279→func CalculatePromptAttribution(
   280→	baseTree *object.Tree,
   281→	lastCheckpointTree *object.Tree,
   282→	worktreeFiles map[string]string,
   283→	checkpointNumber int,
   284→) PromptAttribution {
   285→	result := PromptAttribution{
   286→		CheckpointNumber: checkpointNumber,
   287→	}
   288→
   289→	if len(worktreeFiles) == 0 {
   290→		return result
   291→	}
   292→
   293→	// Determine reference tree for user changes (last checkpoint or base)
   294→	referenceTree := lastCheckpointTree
   295→	if referenceTree == nil {
   296→		referenceTree = baseTree
   297→	}
   298→
   299→	for filePath, worktreeContent := range worktreeFiles {
   300→		referenceContent := getFileContent(referenceTree, filePath)
   301→		baseContent := getFileContent(baseTree, filePath)
   302→
   303→		// User changes: diff(reference, worktree)
   304→		// These are changes since the last checkpoint that the agent didn't make
   305→		_, userAdded, userRemoved := diffLines(referenceContent, worktreeContent)
   306→		result.UserLinesAdded += userAdded
   307→		result.UserLinesRemoved += userRemoved
   308→
   309→		// Agent lines so far: diff(base, lastCheckpoint)
   310→		// Only calculate if we have a previous checkpoint
   311→		if lastCheckpointTree != nil {
   312→			checkpointContent := getFileContent(lastCheckpointTree, filePath)
   313→			_, agentAdded, agentRemoved := diffLines(baseContent, checkpointContent)
   314→			result.AgentLinesAdded += agentAdded
   315→			result.AgentLinesRemoved += agentRemoved
   316→		}
   317→	}
   318→
   319→	return result
   320→}

   364→// calculatePromptAttributionForSave calculates attribution at checkpoint save time.
   365→// This detects user edits since the last checkpoint for files the agent is NOT touching.
   366→//
   367→// The key insight: at SaveChanges time, the worktree contains agent's changes mixed with
   368→// any user edits. We separate them by:
   369→// 1. Files in ctx.ModifiedFiles/NewFiles/DeletedFiles = agent is touching these
   370→// 2. Other files that changed since last checkpoint = user edits between prompts
   371→//
   372→// For files the agent IS touching, we can't distinguish user edits made before the agent
   373→// worked (the worktree has both mixed). Those will be detected by the final attribution
   374→// at commit time (shadow → committed diff).
   375→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) calculatePromptAttributionForSave(
   376→	repo *git.Repository,
   377→	state *SessionState,
   378→	ctx SaveContext,
   379→) PromptAttribution {
   380→	nextCheckpointNum := state.CheckpointCount + 1
   381→
   382→	// Get base tree (the commit when session started)
   383→	var baseTree *object.Tree
   384→	if baseCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(state.BaseCommit)); err == nil {
   385→		if tree, treeErr := baseCommit.Tree(); treeErr == nil {
   386→			baseTree = tree
   387→		}
   388→	}
   389→
   390→	// Get last checkpoint tree (shadow branch, if exists)
   391→	var lastCheckpointTree *object.Tree
   392→	if state.CheckpointCount > 0 {
   393→		shadowBranchName := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit)
   394→		refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   395→		if ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true); err == nil {
   396→			if commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash()); err == nil {
   397→				if tree, treeErr := commit.Tree(); treeErr == nil {
   398→					lastCheckpointTree = tree
   399→				}
   400→			}
   401→		}
   402→	}
   403→
   404→	worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
   405→	if err != nil {
   406→		return PromptAttribution{CheckpointNumber: nextCheckpointNum}
   407→	}
   408→
   409→	// Build set of files the agent is touching in this checkpoint
   410→	agentFiles := make(map[string]bool)
   411→	for _, f := range ctx.ModifiedFiles {
   412→		agentFiles[f] = true
   413→	}
   414→	for _, f := range ctx.NewFiles {
   415→		agentFiles[f] = true
   416→	}
   417→	for _, f := range ctx.DeletedFiles {
   418→		agentFiles[f] = true
   419→	}
   420→
   421→	// Get worktree status to find ALL changed files
   422→	status, err := worktree.Status()
   423→	if err != nil {
   424→		return PromptAttribution{CheckpointNumber: nextCheckpointNum}
   425→	}
   426→
   427→	worktreeRoot := worktree.Filesystem.Root()
   428→
   429→	// Build map of user-changed files (files that changed but agent is NOT touching)
   430→	userFiles := make(map[string]string)
   431→	for filePath, fileStatus := range status {
   432→		// Skip files the agent is touching
   433→		if agentFiles[filePath] {
   434→			continue
   435→		}
   436→		// Skip unmodified files
   437→		if fileStatus.Worktree == git.Unmodified && fileStatus.Staging == git.Unmodified {
   438→			continue
   439→		}
   440→		// Skip .entire metadata directory (session data, not user code)
   441→		if strings.HasPrefix(filePath, paths.EntireMetadataDir+"/") || strings.HasPrefix(filePath, ".entire/") {
   442→			continue
   443→		}
   444→		// This file changed but agent isn't touching it = user edit
   445→		fullPath := filepath.Join(worktreeRoot, filePath)
   446→		content, err := os.ReadFile(fullPath) //nolint:gosec // filePath is from git worktree status
   447→		if err != nil {
   448→			userFiles[filePath] = "" // File deleted or unreadable
   449→		} else {
   450→			userFiles[filePath] = string(content)
   451→		}
   452→	}
   453→
   454→	// Also check files in state.FilesTouched that might have been edited by user
   455→	// These are files the agent touched in previous checkpoints that user might have edited
   456→	for _, filePath := range state.FilesTouched {
   457→		if agentFiles[filePath] {
   458→			continue // Agent touching it this checkpoint
   459→		}
   460→		if _, already := userFiles[filePath]; already {
   461→			continue // Already detected

    95→// StateStore provides low-level operations for managing session state files.
    96→//
    97→// StateStore is a primitive for session state persistence. It is NOT the same as
    98→// the Sessions interface - it only handles state files in .git/entire-sessions/,
    99→// not the full session data which includes checkpoint content.
   100→//
   101→// Use StateStore directly in strategies for performance-critical state operations.
   102→// Use the Sessions interface (when implemented) for high-level session management.
   103→type StateStore struct {
   104→	// stateDir is the directory where session state files are stored
   105→	stateDir string
   106→}
   107→
   108→// NewStateStore creates a new state store.
   109→// Uses the git common dir to store session state (shared across worktrees).
   110→func NewStateStore() (*StateStore, error) {
   111→	commonDir, err := getGitCommonDir()
   112→	if err != nil {
   113→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   114→	}
   115→	return &StateStore{
   116→		stateDir: filepath.Join(commonDir, sessionStateDirName),
   117→	}, nil
   118→}
   119→
   120→// NewStateStoreWithDir creates a new state store with a custom directory.
   121→// This is useful for testing.
   122→func NewStateStoreWithDir(stateDir string) *StateStore {
   123→	return &StateStore{stateDir: stateDir}
   124→}
   125→
   126→// Load loads the session state for the given session ID.
   127→// Returns (nil, nil) when session file doesn't exist (not an error condition).
   128→func (s *StateStore) Load(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) (*State, error) {
   129→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   130→
   131→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   132→	if err := paths.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   133→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   134→	}
   135→
   136→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   137→
   138→	data, err := os.ReadFile(stateFile) //nolint:gosec // stateFile is derived from sessionID
   139→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   140→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil,nil indicates session not found (expected case)
   141→	}
   142→	if err != nil {
   143→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state: %w", err)
   144→	}
   145→
   146→	var state State
   147→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
   148→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal session state: %w", err)
   149→	}
   150→	return &state, nil
   151→}
   152→
   153→// Save saves the session state atomically.
   154→func (s *StateStore) Save(ctx context.Context, state *State) error {
   155→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   156→
   157→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   158→	if err := paths.ValidateSessionID(state.SessionID); err != nil {
   159→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   160→	}
   161→
   162→	if err := os.MkdirAll(s.stateDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   163→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session state directory: %w", err)
   164→	}
   165→
   166→	data, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(state, "", "  ")
   167→	if err != nil {
   168→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal session state: %w", err)
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(state.SessionID)
   172→
   173→	// Atomic write: write to temp file, then rename
   174→	tmpFile := stateFile + ".tmp"
   175→	if err := os.WriteFile(tmpFile, data, 0o600); err != nil {
   176→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session state: %w", err)
   177→	}
   178→	if err := os.Rename(tmpFile, stateFile); err != nil {
   179→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to rename session state file: %w", err)
   180→	}
   181→	return nil
   182→}
   183→
   184→// Clear removes the session state file for the given session ID.
   185→func (s *StateStore) Clear(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   186→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   187→
   188→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   189→	if err := paths.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   190→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   191→	}
   192→
   193→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   194→
   195→	if err := os.Remove(stateFile); err != nil {
   196→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   197→			return nil // Already gone, not an error
   198→		}
   199→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state file: %w", err)
   200→	}
   201→	return nil
   202→}
   203→
   204→// List returns all session states.
   205→func (s *StateStore) List(ctx context.Context) ([]*State, error) {
   206→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   207→
   208→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.stateDir)
   209→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   210→		return nil, nil
   211→	}
   212→	if err != nil {
   213→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state directory: %w", err)
   214→	}
   215→
   216→	var states []*State
   217→	for _, entry := range entries {
   218→		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
   219→			continue
   220→		}
   221→		if strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".tmp") {
   222→			continue // Skip temp files
   223→		}
   224→
   225→		sessionID := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json")
   226→		state, err := s.Load(ctx, sessionID)
   227→		if err != nil {
   228→			continue // Skip corrupted state files
   229→		}
   230→		if state == nil {
   231→			continue
   232→		}
   233→
   234→		states = append(states, state)
   235→	}
   236→	return states, nil
   237→}
   238→
   239→// FindByBaseCommit finds all sessions based on the given commit hash.
   240→func (s *StateStore) FindByBaseCommit(ctx context.Context, baseCommit string) ([]*State, error) {
   241→	allStates, err := s.List(ctx)
   242→	if err != nil {
   243→		return nil, err
   244→	}
   245→
   246→	var matching []*State
   247→	for _, state := range allStates {
   248→		if state.BaseCommit == baseCommit {
   249→			matching = append(matching, state)
   250→		}
   251→	}
   252→	return matching, nil
   253→}
   254→
   255→// FindByWorktree finds all sessions for the given worktree path.
   256→func (s *StateStore) FindByWorktree(ctx context.Context, worktreePath string) ([]*State, error) {
   257→	allStates, err := s.List(ctx)
   258→	if err != nil {
   259→		return nil, err
   260→	}
   261→
   262→	var matching []*State
   263→	for _, state := range allStates {
   264→		if state.WorktreePath == worktreePath {
   265→			matching = append(matching, state)
   266→		}
   267→	}
   268→	return matching, nil
   269→}
   270→
   271→// stateFilePath returns the path to a session state file.
   272→func (s *StateStore) stateFilePath(sessionID string) string {
   273→	return filepath.Join(s.stateDir, sessionID+".json")
   274→}
   275→
   276→// getGitCommonDir returns the path to the shared git directory.
   277→// In a regular checkout, this is .git/
   278→// In a worktree, this is the main repo's .git/ (not .git/worktrees/<name>/)
   279→func getGitCommonDir() (string, error) {
   280→	ctx := context.Background()
   281→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
   282→	cmd.Dir = "."
   283→	output, err := cmd.Output()
   284→	if err != nil {
   285→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   286→	}
   287→
   288→	commonDir := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
   289→
   290→	// git rev-parse --git-common-dir returns relative paths from the working directory,
   291→	// so we need to make it absolute if it isn't already
   292→	if !filepath.IsAbs(commonDir) {
   293→		commonDir = filepath.Join(".", commonDir)
   294→	}
   295→
   296→	return filepath.Clean(commonDir), nil
   297→}
   298→
   299→// GetWorktreePath returns the absolute path to the current worktree root.
   300→func GetWorktreePath() (string, error) {
   301→	ctx := context.Background()
   302→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")
   303→	output, err := cmd.Output()
   304→	if err != nil {
   305→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree path: %w", err)
   306→	}
   307→	return strings.TrimSpace(string(output)), nil
   308→}

    25→// askConfirmTTY prompts the user for a yes/no confirmation via /dev/tty.
    26→// This works even when stdin is redirected (e.g., git commit -m).
    27→// Returns true for yes, false for no. If TTY is unavailable, returns the default.
    28→// If context is non-empty, it is displayed on a separate line before the prompt.
    29→func askConfirmTTY(prompt string, context string, defaultYes bool) bool {
    30→	// Open /dev/tty for both reading and writing
    31→	// This is the controlling terminal, which works even when stdin/stderr are redirected
    32→	tty, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
    33→	if err != nil {
    34→		// Can't open TTY (e.g., running in CI), use default
    35→		return defaultYes
    36→	}
    37→	defer tty.Close()
    38→
    39→	// Show context if provided
    40→	if context != "" {
    41→		fmt.Fprintf(tty, "%s\n", context)
    42→	}
    43→
    44→	// Show prompt with default indicator
    45→	// Write to tty directly, not stderr, since git hooks may redirect stderr to /dev/null
    46→	var hint string
    47→	if defaultYes {
    48→		hint = "[Y/n]"
    49→	} else {
    50→		hint = "[y/N]"
    51→	}
    52→	fmt.Fprintf(tty, "%s %s ", prompt, hint)
    53→
    54→	// Read response
    55→	reader := bufio.NewReader(tty)
    56→	response, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
    57→	if err != nil {
    58→		return defaultYes
    59→	}
    60→
    61→	response = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(response))
    62→	switch response {
    63→	case "y", "yes":
    64→		return true
    65→	case "n", "no":
    66→		return false
    67→	default:
    68→		// Empty or invalid input - use default
    69→		return defaultYes
    70→	}
    71→}
    72→
    73→// CommitMsg is called by the git commit-msg hook after the user edits the message.
    74→// If the message contains only our trailer (no actual user content), strip it
    75→// so git will abort the commit due to empty message.
    76→//
    77→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
    78→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CommitMsg(commitMsgFile string) error {
    79→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // Path comes from git hook
    80→	if err != nil {
    81→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
    82→	}
    83→
    84→	message := string(content)
    85→
    86→	// Check if our trailer is present (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
    87→	if _, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); !found {
    88→		// No trailer, nothing to do
    89→		return nil
    90→	}
    91→
    92→	// Check if there's any user content (non-comment, non-trailer lines)
    93→	if !hasUserContent(message) {
    94→		// No user content - strip the trailer so git aborts
    95→		message = stripCheckpointTrailer(message)
    96→		if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
    97→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
    98→		}
    99→	}
   100→
   101→	return nil
   102→}
   103→
   104→// hasUserContent checks if the message has any content besides comments and our trailer.
   105→func hasUserContent(message string) bool {
   106→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   107→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   108→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   109→		// Skip empty lines
   110→		if trimmed == "" {
   111→			continue
   112→		}
   113→		// Skip comment lines
   114→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "#") {
   115→			continue
   116→		}
   117→		// Skip our trailer line
   118→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, trailerPrefix) {
   119→			continue
   120→		}
   121→		// Found user content
   122→		return true
   123→	}
   124→	return false
   125→}
   126→
   127→// stripCheckpointTrailer removes the Entire-Checkpoint trailer line from the message.
   128→func stripCheckpointTrailer(message string) string {
   129→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   130→	var result []string
   131→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   132→		if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), trailerPrefix) {
   133→			result = append(result, line)
   134→		}
   135→	}
   136→	return strings.Join(result, "\n")
   137→}

   139→// PrepareCommitMsg is called by the git prepare-commit-msg hook.
   140→// Adds an Entire-Checkpoint trailer to the commit message with a stable checkpoint ID.
   141→// Only adds a trailer if there's actually new session content to condense.
   142→// The actual condensation happens in PostCommit - if the user removes the trailer,
   143→// the commit will not be linked to the session (useful for "manual" commits).
   144→// For amended commits, preserves the existing checkpoint ID.
   145→//
   146→// The source parameter indicates how the commit was initiated:
   147→//   - "" or "template": normal editor flow - adds trailer with explanatory comment
   148→//   - "message": using -m or -F flag - prompts user interactively via /dev/tty
   149→//   - "merge", "squash", "commit": skip trailer entirely (auto-generated or amend commits)
   150→//
   151→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
   152→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PrepareCommitMsg(commitMsgFile string, source string) error {
   153→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   154→
   155→	// Skip for merge, squash, and commit (amend) sources
   156→	// These are auto-generated or reusing existing messages - not from Claude sessions

   159→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: skipped for source",
   160→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   161→			slog.String("source", source),
   162→		)
   163→		return nil
   164→	}

   173→	}

   175→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   176→	// We match by worktree (not BaseCommit) because the user may have made

   186→	}

   188→	// Check if any session has new content to condense
   189→	sessionsWithContent := s.filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo, sessions)

   192→	var checkpointID id.CheckpointID

   206→		// Get current HEAD to filter sessions
   207→		head, err := repo.Head()

   210→		}
   211→		currentHeadHash := head.Hash().String()

   217→		// reusing checkpoint IDs). If none match, we don't add a trailer rather than
   218→		// falling back to old sessions which could have stale checkpoint IDs.
   219→		var currentSessions []*SessionState

   224→		}

   226→		if len(currentSessions) == 0 {

   228→			// from old sessions as they may be stale

   258→
   259→	// Read current commit message
   260→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   261→	if err != nil {
   262→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   263→	}
   264→
   265→	message := string(content)
   266→
   267→	// Get or generate checkpoint ID (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
   268→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   269→		// Trailer already exists (e.g., amend) - keep it
   270→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer already exists",
   271→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   272→			slog.String("source", source),
   273→			slog.String("existing_checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   274→		)
   275→		return nil
   276→	}
   277→
   278→	if hasNewContent {
   279→		// New content: generate new checkpoint ID
   280→		cpID, err := id.Generate()
   281→		if err != nil {
   282→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   283→		}
   284→		checkpointID = cpID
   285→	}
   286→	// Otherwise checkpointID is already set to LastCheckpointID from above
   287→
   288→	// Determine agent type and last prompt from session
   289→	agentType := DefaultAgentType // default for backward compatibility
   290→	var lastPrompt string
   291→	if hasNewContent && len(sessionsWithContent) > 0 {
   292→		session := sessionsWithContent[0]
   293→		if session.AgentType != "" {
   294→			agentType = session.AgentType
   295→		}
   296→		lastPrompt = s.getLastPrompt(repo, session)
   297→	} else if reusedSession != nil {
   298→		// Reusing checkpoint from existing session - get agent type and prompt from that session
   299→		if reusedSession.AgentType != "" {
   300→			agentType = reusedSession.AgentType
   301→		}
   302→		lastPrompt = s.getLastPrompt(repo, reusedSession)
   303→	}
   304→
   305→	// Prepare prompt for display: collapse newlines/whitespace, then truncate (rune-safe)
   306→	displayPrompt := stringutil.TruncateRunes(stringutil.CollapseWhitespace(lastPrompt), 80, "...")
   307→
   308→	// Add trailer differently based on commit source
   309→	if source == "message" {
   310→		// Using -m or -F: ask user interactively whether to add trailer
   311→		// (comments won't be stripped by git in this mode)
   312→
   313→		// Build context string for interactive prompt
   314→		var promptContext string
   315→		if displayPrompt != "" {
   316→			promptContext = "You have an active " + string(agentType) + " session.\nLast Prompt: " + displayPrompt
   317→		}
   318→
   319→		if !askConfirmTTY("Link this commit to "+string(agentType)+" session context?", promptContext, true) {
   320→			// User declined - don't add trailer
   321→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: user declined trailer",
   322→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   323→				slog.String("source", source),
   324→			)
   325→			return nil
   326→		}
   327→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   328→	} else {
   329→		// Normal editor flow: add trailer with explanatory comment (will be stripped by git)
   330→		message = addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message, checkpointID, string(agentType), displayPrompt)
   331→	}
   332→
   333→	logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer added",
   334→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   335→		slog.String("source", source),
   336→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   337→		slog.Bool("has_new_content", hasNewContent),
   338→	)
   339→
   340→	// Write updated message back
   341→	if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
   342→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   343→	}
   344→
   345→	return nil
   346→}
   347→
   348→// PostCommit is called by the git post-commit hook after a commit is created.
   349→// Checks if the commit has an Entire-Checkpoint trailer and if so, condenses
   350→// session data from shadow branches to entire/sessions.
   351→// If the user removed the trailer during commit message editing, this is treated
   352→// as a "manual" commit and no condensation happens.
   353→//
   354→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
   355→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PostCommit() error {
   356→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   357→
   358→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   359→	if err != nil {
   360→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   361→	}
   362→
   363→	// Get HEAD commit to check for trailer
   364→	head, err := repo.Head()
   365→	if err != nil {
   366→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   367→	}
   368→
   369→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   370→	if err != nil {
   371→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   372→	}
   373→
   374→	// Check if commit has checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
   375→	checkpointID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   376→	if !found {
   377→		// No trailer - user removed it, treat as manual commit
   378→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: no checkpoint trailer",
   379→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   380→		)
   381→		return nil
   382→	}
   383→
   384→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   385→	if err != nil {
   386→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   387→	}
   388→
   389→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   390→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   391→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   392→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: no active sessions despite trailer",
   393→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   394→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   395→		)
   396→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   397→	}
   398→
   399→	// Filter to sessions with new content
   400→	sessionsWithContent := s.filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo, sessions)
   401→	if len(sessionsWithContent) == 0 {
   402→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: no new content to condense",
   403→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   404→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   405→			slog.Int("sessions_found", len(sessions)),
   406→		)
   407→		// Still update BaseCommit for all sessions in this worktree
   408→		// This prevents stale BaseCommit when commits happen without condensation
   409→		// (e.g., when reusing a previous checkpoint ID for split commits)
   410→		newHead := head.Hash().String()
   411→		for _, state := range sessions {
   412→			if state.BaseCommit != newHead {
   413→				state.BaseCommit = newHead
   414→				if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   415→					logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: failed to update session BaseCommit",
   416→						slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   417→						slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   418→					)
   419→				}
   420→			}
   421→		}
   422→		return nil
   423→	}
   424→
   425→	// Track shadow branches to clean up after successful condensation
   426→	shadowBranchesToDelete := make(map[string]struct{})
   427→
   428→	// Condense sessions that have new content
   429→	for _, state := range sessionsWithContent {
   430→		result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state)
   431→		if err != nil {
   432→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: condensation failed for session %s: %v\n",
   433→				state.SessionID, err)
   434→			continue
   435→		}
   436→
   437→		// Track this shadow branch for cleanup
   438→		shadowBranchesToDelete[state.BaseCommit] = struct{}{}
   439→
   440→		// Update session state for the new base commit
   441→		// After condensation, the session continues from the NEW commit (HEAD), so we:
   442→		// 1. Update BaseCommit to new HEAD - session now tracks from new commit
   443→		// 2. Reset CheckpointCount to 0 - no checkpoints exist on new shadow branch yet
   444→		// 3. Update CondensedTranscriptLines - track transcript position for detecting new content
   445→		//
   446→		// This is critical: if we don't update BaseCommit, listAllSessionStates will try
   447→		// to find shadow branch for old commit (which gets deleted), and since CheckpointCount > 0,
   448→		// it will clean up (delete) the session state file. By updating to new HEAD with
   449→		// CheckpointCount = 0, the session is preserved even without a shadow branch.
   450→		state.BaseCommit = head.Hash().String()
   451→		state.CheckpointCount = 0
   452→		state.CondensedTranscriptLines = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   453→
   454→		// Save checkpoint ID so subsequent commits without new content can reuse it
   455→		state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   456→
   457→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   458→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", err)
   459→		}
   460→
   461→		shortID := state.SessionID
   462→		if len(shortID) > 8 {
   463→			shortID = shortID[:8]
   464→		}
   465→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Condensed session %s: %s (%d checkpoints)\n",
   466→			shortID, result.CheckpointID, result.CheckpointsCount)
   467→
   468→		// Log condensation
   469→		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   470→		logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed",
   471→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   472→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   473→			slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   474→			slog.Int("transcript_lines", result.TotalTranscriptLines),
   475→		)
   476→	}
   477→
   478→	// Clean up shadow branches after successful condensation
   479→	// Data is now preserved on entire/sessions, so shadow branches are no longer needed
   480→	for baseCommit := range shadowBranchesToDelete {
   481→		shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit)
   482→		if err := deleteShadowBranch(repo, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   483→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to clean up %s: %v\n", shadowBranchName, err)
   484→		} else {
   485→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Cleaned up shadow branch: %s\n", shadowBranchName)
   486→
   487→			// Log branch cleanup
   488→			logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   489→			logging.Info(logCtx, "shadow branch deleted",
   490→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   491→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   492→			)
   493→		}
   494→	}
   495→
   496→	return nil
   497→}
   498→
   499→// filterSessionsWithNewContent returns sessions that have new transcript content
   500→// beyond what was already condensed.
   501→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo *git.Repository, sessions []*SessionState) []*SessionState {
   502→	var result []*SessionState
   503→
   504→	for _, state := range sessions {
   505→		hasNew, err := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   506→		if err != nil {
   507→			// On error, include the session (fail open for hooks)
   508→			result = append(result, state)
   509→			continue
   510→		}
   511→		if hasNew {
   512→			result = append(result, state)
   513→		}
   514→	}
   515→
   516→	return result
   517→}
   518→
   519→// sessionHasNewContent checks if a session has new transcript content
   520→// beyond what was already condensed.
   521→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContent(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   522→	// Get shadow branch
   523→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit)
   524→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   525→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   526→	if err != nil {
   527→		// No shadow branch means no Stop has happened since the last condensation.
   528→		// However, the agent may have done work (including commits) without a Stop.
   529→		// Check the live transcript to detect this scenario.
   530→		return s.sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo, state)
   531→	}
   532→
   533→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   534→	if err != nil {
   535→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   536→	}
   537→
   538→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   539→	if err != nil {
   540→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   541→	}
   542→
   543→	// Look for transcript file
   544→	metadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + state.SessionID
   545→	var transcriptLines int
   546→
   547→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   548→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   549→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
   550→		}
   551→	} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   552→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   553→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
   554→		}
   555→	}
   556→
   557→	// Has new content if there are more lines than already condensed
   558→	return transcriptLines > state.CondensedTranscriptLines, nil
   559→}
   560→
   561→// countTranscriptLines counts lines in a transcript, matching the counting method used
   562→// in extractSessionData for consistency. This trims trailing empty lines (from final \n
   563→// in JSONL) but includes empty lines in the middle of the file.
   564→func countTranscriptLines(content string) int {
   565→	lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   566→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   567→	for len(lines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(lines[len(lines)-1]) == "" {
   568→		lines = lines[:len(lines)-1]
   569→	}
   570→	return len(lines)
   571→}
   572→
   573→// sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript checks if a session has new content
   574→// by examining the live transcript file. This is used when no shadow branch exists
   575→// (i.e., no Stop has happened yet) but the agent may have done work.
   576→//
   577→// Returns true if:
   578→//  1. The transcript has grown since the last condensation, AND
   579→//  2. The new transcript portion contains file modifications, AND
   580→//  3. At least one modified file overlaps with the currently staged files
   581→//
   582→// The overlap check ensures we don't add checkpoint trailers to commits that are
   583→// unrelated to the agent's recent changes.
   584→//
   585→// This handles the scenario where the agent commits mid-session before Stop.
   586→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   587→	// Need both transcript path and agent type to analyze
   588→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" || state.AgentType == "" {
   589→		return false, nil
   590→	}
   591→
   592→	// Get the agent for transcript analysis
   593→	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType)
   594→	if err != nil {
   595→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Unknown agent type, fail gracefully
   596→	}
   597→
   598→	// Cast to TranscriptAnalyzer
   599→	analyzer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptAnalyzer)
   600→	if !ok {
   601→		return false, nil // Agent doesn't support transcript analysis
   602→	}
   603→
   604→	// Get current transcript position
   605→	currentPos, err := analyzer.GetTranscriptPosition(state.TranscriptPath)
   606→	if err != nil {
   607→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error reading transcript, fail gracefully
   608→	}
   609→
   610→	// Check if transcript has grown since last condensation
   611→	if currentPos <= state.CondensedTranscriptLines {
   612→		return false, nil // No new content
   613→	}
   614→
   615→	// Transcript has grown - check if there are file modifications in the new portion
   616→	modifiedFiles, _, err := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(state.TranscriptPath, state.CondensedTranscriptLines)
   617→	if err != nil {
   618→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error parsing transcript, fail gracefully
   619→	}
   620→
   621→	// No file modifications means no new content to checkpoint
   622→	if len(modifiedFiles) == 0 {
   623→		return false, nil
   624→	}
   625→
   626→	// Check if any modified files overlap with currently staged files
   627→	// This ensures we only add checkpoint trailers to commits that include
   628→	// files the agent actually modified
   629→	stagedFiles := getStagedFiles(repo)
   630→	if !hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, modifiedFiles) {
   631→		return false, nil // No overlap - staged files are unrelated to agent's work
   632→	}
   633→
   634→	return true, nil
   635→}
   636→
   637→// addCheckpointTrailer adds the Entire-Checkpoint trailer to a commit message.
   638→// Handles proper trailer formatting (blank line before trailers if needed).
   639→func addCheckpointTrailer(message string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) string {
   640→	trailer := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ": " + checkpointID.String()
   641→
   642→	// If message already ends with trailers (lines starting with key:), just append
   643→	// Otherwise, add a blank line first
   644→	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(message, "\n"), "\n")
   645→
   646→	// Check if last non-empty, non-comment line looks like a trailer
   647→	// Git comment lines start with # and may contain ": " (e.g., "# Changes to be committed:")
   648→	hasTrailers := false
   649→	for i := len(lines) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   650→		line := strings.TrimSpace(lines[i])
   651→		if line == "" {
   652→			break
   653→		}
   654→		// Skip git comment lines
   655→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
   656→			continue
   657→		}
   658→		if strings.Contains(line, ": ") {
   659→			hasTrailers = true
   660→			break
   661→		}
   662→		// Non-comment, non-trailer line found - no existing trailers
   663→		break
   664→	}
   665→
   666→	if hasTrailers {
   667→		// Append trailer directly
   668→		return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n" + trailer + "\n"
   669→	}
   670→
   671→	// Add blank line before trailer
   672→	return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n"
   673→}
   674→
   675→// addCheckpointTrailerWithComment adds the Entire-Checkpoint trailer with an explanatory comment.
   676→// The trailer is placed above the git comment block but below the user's message area,
   677→// with a comment explaining that the user can remove it if they don't want to link the commit
   678→// to the agent session. If prompt is non-empty, it's shown as context.
   679→func addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, agentName, prompt string) string {
   680→	trailer := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ": " + checkpointID.String()
   681→	commentLines := []string{
   682→		"# Remove the Entire-Checkpoint trailer above if you don't want to link this commit to " + agentName + " session context.",
   683→	}
   684→	if prompt != "" {
   685→		commentLines = append(commentLines, "# Last Prompt: "+prompt)
   686→	}
   687→	commentLines = append(commentLines, "# The trailer will be added to your next commit based on this branch.")
   688→	comment := strings.Join(commentLines, "\n")
   689→
   690→	lines := strings.Split(message, "\n")
   691→
   692→	// Find where the git comment block starts (first # line)
   693→	commentStart := -1
   694→	for i, line := range lines {
   695→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
   696→			commentStart = i
   697→			break
   698→		}
   699→	}
   700→
   701→	if commentStart == -1 {
   702→		// No git comments, append trailer at the end
   703→		return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n"
   704→	}
   705→
   706→	// Split into user content and git comments
   707→	userContent := strings.Join(lines[:commentStart], "\n")
   708→	gitComments := strings.Join(lines[commentStart:], "\n")
   709→
   710→	// Build result: user content, blank line, trailer, comment, blank line, git comments
   711→	userContent = strings.TrimRight(userContent, "\n")
   712→	if userContent == "" {
   713→		// No user content yet - leave space for them to type, then trailer
   714→		// Two newlines: first for user's message line, second for blank separator
   715→		return "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n\n" + gitComments
   716→	}
   717→	return userContent + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n\n" + gitComments
   718→}
   719→
   720→// InitializeSession creates session state for a new session or updates an existing one.
   721→// This implements the optional SessionInitializer interface.
   722→// Called during UserPromptSubmit to allow git hooks to detect active sessions.
   723→//
   724→// If the session already exists and HEAD has moved (e.g., user committed), updates
   725→// BaseCommit to the new HEAD so future checkpoints go to the correct shadow branch.
   726→//
   727→// If there's an existing shadow branch with activity from a different worktree,
   728→// returns a ShadowBranchConflictError to allow the caller to inform the user.
   729→//
   730→// agentType is the human-readable name of the agent (e.g., "Claude Code").
   731→// transcriptPath is the path to the live transcript file (for mid-session commit detection).
   732→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) InitializeSession(sessionID string, agentType agent.AgentType, transcriptPath string) error {
   733→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   734→	if err != nil {
   735→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
   736→	}
   737→
   738→	// Get current HEAD
   739→	head, err := repo.Head()
   740→	if err != nil {
   741→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   742→	}
   743→
   744→	// Check if session already exists
   745→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   746→	if err != nil {
   747→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to check session state: %w", err)
   748→	}
   749→
   750→	// Check for shadow branch conflict before proceeding
   751→	// This must happen even if session state exists but has no checkpoints yet
   752→	// (e.g., state was created by concurrent warning but conflict later resolved)
   753→	baseCommitHash := head.Hash().String()
   754→	if state == nil || state.CheckpointCount == 0 {
   755→		shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommitHash)
   756→		refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
   757→
   758→		ref, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   759→		if refErr == nil {
   760→			// Shadow branch exists - check if it has commits from a different session
   761→			tipCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   762→			if commitErr == nil {
   763→				existingSessionID, found := trailers.ParseSession(tipCommit.Message)
   764→				if found && existingSessionID != sessionID {
   765→					// Check if the existing session has a state file
   766→					// existingSessionID is the full Entire session ID (YYYY-MM-DD-uuid) from the trailer
   767→					// We intentionally ignore load errors - treat them as "no state" (orphaned branch)
   768→					existingState, _ := s.loadSessionState(existingSessionID) //nolint:errcheck // error means no state
   769→					if existingState == nil {
   770→						// Orphaned shadow branch - no state file for the existing session
   771→						// Reset the branch so the new session can proceed
   772→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Resetting orphaned shadow branch '%s' (previous session %s has no state)\n",
   773→							shadowBranch, existingSessionID)
   774→						if err := deleteShadowBranch(repo, shadowBranch); err != nil {
   775→							return fmt.Errorf("failed to reset orphaned shadow branch: %w", err)
   776→						}
   777→					} else {
   778→						// Existing session has state - this is a real conflict
   779→						// (e.g., different worktree at same commit)
   780→						return &SessionIDConflictError{
   781→							ExistingSession: existingSessionID,
   782→							NewSession:      sessionID,
   783→							ShadowBranch:    shadowBranch,
   784→						}
   785→					}
   786→				}
   787→			}
   788→		}
   789→	}
   790→
   791→	if state != nil && state.BaseCommit != "" {
   792→		// Session is fully initialized
   793→		needSave := false
   794→
   795→		// Backfill AgentType if empty (for sessions created before the agent_type field was added)
   796→		if state.AgentType == "" && agentType != "" {
   797→			state.AgentType = agentType
   798→			needSave = true
   799→		}
   800→
   801→		// Update transcript path if provided (may change on session resume)
   802→		if transcriptPath != "" && state.TranscriptPath != transcriptPath {
   803→			state.TranscriptPath = transcriptPath
   804→			needSave = true
   805→		}
   806→
   807→		// Clear LastCheckpointID on every new prompt
   808→		// This is set during PostCommit when a checkpoint is created, and should be
   809→		// cleared when the user enters a new prompt (starting fresh work)
   810→		if state.LastCheckpointID != "" {
   811→			state.LastCheckpointID = ""
   812→			needSave = true
   813→		}
   814→
   815→		// Calculate attribution at prompt start (BEFORE agent makes any changes)
   816→		// This captures user edits since the last checkpoint
   817→		if state.CheckpointCount > 0 {
   818→			// Only calculate if there's a previous checkpoint to compare against
   819→			promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
   820→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[DEBUG InitializeSession] calculated: user_added=%d user_removed=%d\n", promptAttr.UserLinesAdded, promptAttr.UserLinesRemoved)
   821→			if promptAttr.UserLinesAdded > 0 || promptAttr.UserLinesRemoved > 0 {
   822→				state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr
   823→				needSave = true
   824→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[DEBUG InitializeSession] set PendingPromptAttribution, needSave=true\n")
   825→			}
   826→		}
   827→
   828→		// Check if HEAD has moved (user pulled/rebased or committed)
   829→		if state.BaseCommit != head.Hash().String() {
   830→			oldBaseCommit := state.BaseCommit
   831→			newBaseCommit := head.Hash().String()
   832→
   833→			// Check if old shadow branch exists - if so, user did NOT commit (would have been deleted)
   834→			// This happens when user does: stash → pull → stash apply, or rebase, etc.
   835→			oldShadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(oldBaseCommit)
   836→			oldRefName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(oldShadowBranch)
   837→			if oldRef, err := repo.Reference(oldRefName, true); err == nil {
   838→				// Old shadow branch exists - move it to new base commit
   839→				newShadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(newBaseCommit)
   840→				newRefName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(newShadowBranch)
   841→
   842→				// Create new reference pointing to same commit
   843→				newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(newRefName, oldRef.Hash())
   844→				if err := repo.Storer.SetReference(newRef); err != nil {
   845→					return fmt.Errorf("failed to create new shadow branch %s: %w", newShadowBranch, err)
   846→				}
   847→
   848→				// Delete old reference
   849→				if err := repo.Storer.RemoveReference(oldRefName); err != nil {
   850→					// Non-fatal: log but continue
   851→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to remove old shadow branch %s: %v\n", oldShadowBranch, err)
   852→				}
   853→
   854→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Moved shadow branch from %s to %s (base commit changed after pull/rebase)\n",
   855→					oldShadowBranch, newShadowBranch)
   856→			}
   857→
   858→			state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   859→			needSave = true
   860→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session base commit to %s\n", newBaseCommit[:7])
   861→		}
   862→
   863→		if needSave {
   864→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[DEBUG InitializeSession] saving state with PendingPromptAttribution=%v\n", state.PendingPromptAttribution)
   865→			if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   866→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to update session state: %w", err)
   867→			}
   868→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[DEBUG InitializeSession] state saved successfully\n")
   869→		}
   870→		return nil
   871→	}
   872→	// If state exists but BaseCommit is empty, it's a partial state from concurrent warning
   873→	// Continue below to properly initialize it
   874→
   875→	currentWorktree, err := GetWorktreePath()
   876→	if err != nil {
   877→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree path: %w", err)
   878→	}
   879→
   880→	// Check for existing sessions on the same base commit from different worktrees
   881→	existingSessions, err := s.findSessionsForCommit(head.Hash().String())
   882→	if err != nil {
   883→		// Log but continue - conflict detection is best-effort
   884→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to check for existing sessions: %v\n", err)
   885→	} else {
   886→		for _, existingState := range existingSessions {
   887→			// Skip sessions from the same worktree
   888→			if existingState.WorktreePath == currentWorktree {
   889→				continue
   890→			}
   891→
   892→			// Found a session from a different worktree on the same base commit
   893→			shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(head.Hash().String())
   894→			return &ShadowBranchConflictError{
   895→				Branch:           shadowBranch,
   896→				ExistingSession:  existingState.SessionID,
   897→				ExistingWorktree: existingState.WorktreePath,
   898→				LastActivity:     existingState.StartedAt,
   899→				CurrentSession:   sessionID,
   900→				CurrentWorktree:  currentWorktree,
   901→			}
   902→		}
   903→	}
   904→
   905→	// Initialize new session
   906→	_, err = s.initializeSession(repo, sessionID, agentType, transcriptPath)
   907→	if err != nil {
   908→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize session: %w", err)
   909→	}
   910→
   911→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Initialized shadow session: %s\n", sessionID)
   912→	return nil
   913→}
   914→
   915→// calculatePromptAttributionAtStart calculates attribution at prompt start (before agent runs).
   916→// This captures ALL user changes since the last checkpoint - no filtering needed since
   917→// the agent hasn't made any changes yet.
   918→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(
   919→	repo *git.Repository,
   920→	state *SessionState,
   921→) PromptAttribution {
   922→	nextCheckpointNum := state.CheckpointCount + 1
   923→	result := PromptAttribution{CheckpointNumber: nextCheckpointNum}
   924→
   925→	// Get last checkpoint tree from shadow branch
   926→	shadowBranchName := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit)
   927→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   928→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   929→	if err != nil {
   930→		return result // No shadow branch yet
   931→	}
   932→
   933→	shadowCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   934→	if err != nil {
   935→		return result
   936→	}
   937→
   938→	lastCheckpointTree, err := shadowCommit.Tree()
   939→	if err != nil {
   940→		return result
   941→	}
   942→
   943→	// Get base tree for agent lines calculation
   944→	var baseTree *object.Tree
   945→	if baseCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(state.BaseCommit)); err == nil {
   946→		if tree, treeErr := baseCommit.Tree(); treeErr == nil {
   947→			baseTree = tree
   948→		}
   949→	}
   950→
   951→	worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
   952→	if err != nil {
   953→		return result
   954→	}
   955→
   956→	// Get worktree status to find ALL changed files
   957→	status, err := worktree.Status()
   958→	if err != nil {
   959→		return result
   960→	}
   961→
   962→	worktreeRoot := worktree.Filesystem.Root()
   963→
   964→	// Build map of changed files with their current worktree content
   965→	changedFiles := make(map[string]string)
   966→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[DEBUG] calculatePromptAttributionAtStart: status has %d files, checkpoint_count=%d\n", len(status), state.CheckpointCount)
   967→	for filePath, fileStatus := range status {
   968→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[DEBUG] file=%s worktree=%v staging=%v\n", filePath, fileStatus.Worktree, fileStatus.Staging)
   969→		// Skip unmodified files
   970→		if fileStatus.Worktree == git.Unmodified && fileStatus.Staging == git.Unmodified {
   971→			continue
   972→		}
   973→		// Skip .entire metadata directory (session data, not user code)
   974→		if strings.HasPrefix(filePath, paths.EntireMetadataDir+"/") || strings.HasPrefix(filePath, ".entire/") {
   975→			continue
   976→		}
   977→		// Read current worktree content
   978→		fullPath := filepath.Join(worktreeRoot, filePath)
   979→		content, err := os.ReadFile(fullPath) //nolint:gosec // filePath is from git worktree status
   980→		if err != nil {
   981→			changedFiles[filePath] = "" // File deleted or unreadable
   982→		} else {
   983→			changedFiles[filePath] = string(content)
   984→		}
   985→	}
   986→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[DEBUG] changedFiles has %d files\n", len(changedFiles))
   987→
   988→	// Use CalculatePromptAttribution from manual_commit_attribution.go
   989→	result = CalculatePromptAttribution(baseTree, lastCheckpointTree, changedFiles, nextCheckpointNum)
   990→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[DEBUG] result: user_added=%d user_removed=%d\n", result.UserLinesAdded, result.UserLinesRemoved)
   991→
   992→	return result
   993→}
   994→
   995→// getStagedFiles returns a list of files staged for commit.
   996→func getStagedFiles(repo *git.Repository) []string {
   997→	worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
   998→	if err != nil {
   999→		return nil
  1000→	}
  1001→
  1002→	status, err := worktree.Status()
  1003→	if err != nil {
  1004→		return nil
  1005→	}
  1006→
  1007→	var staged []string
  1008→	for path, fileStatus := range status {
  1009→		// Check if file is staged (in index)
  1010→		if fileStatus.Staging != git.Unmodified && fileStatus.Staging != git.Untracked {
  1011→			staged = append(staged, path)
  1012→		}
  1013→	}
  1014→	return staged
  1015→}
  1016→
  1017→// getLastPrompt retrieves the most recent user prompt from a session's shadow branch.
  1018→// Returns empty string if no prompt can be retrieved.
  1019→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getLastPrompt(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) string {
  1020→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit)
  1021→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
  1022→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
  1023→	if err != nil {
  1024→		return ""
  1025→	}
  1026→
  1027→	// Extract session data to get prompts for commit message generation
  1028→	// Pass agent type to handle different transcript formats (JSONL for Claude, JSON for Gemini)
  1029→	sessionData, err := s.extractSessionData(repo, ref.Hash(), state.SessionID, nil, state.AgentType)
  1030→	if err != nil || len(sessionData.Prompts) == 0 {
  1031→		return ""
  1032→	}
  1033→
  1034→	// Return the last prompt (most recent work before commit)
  1035→	return sessionData.Prompts[len(sessionData.Prompts)-1]
  1036→}
  1037→
  1038→// hasOverlappingFiles checks if any file in stagedFiles appears in filesTouched.
  1039→func hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, filesTouched []string) bool {
  1040→	touchedSet := make(map[string]bool)
  1041→	for _, f := range filesTouched {
  1042→		touchedSet[f] = true
  1043→	}
  1044→
  1045→	for _, staged := range stagedFiles {
  1046→		if touchedSet[staged] {
  1047→			return true
  1048→		}
  1049→	}
  1050→	return false
  1051→}

The fix is complete. Here's a summary of what was done:

**Problem**: User edits between prompts were being double-counted - once in prompt attribution and again in the shadow→head diff. This happened because attribution was calculated at checkpoint SAVE time (after the agent runs).

**Solution**: Move attribution calculation to prompt START time (before agent runs) using the existing `UserPromptSubmit` hook.

**Changes made**:
1. Added `PendingPromptAttribution` field to `SessionState` (`manual_commit_types.go`) and `session.State` (`session/state.go`)
2. Added `calculatePromptAttributionAtStart` function in `manual_commit_hooks.go`
3. Updated `InitializeSession` to calculate and store pending attribution
4. Updated `SaveChanges` to use the pending attribution instead of calculating
5. Updated conversion functions in `manual_commit.go` to include `PendingPromptAttribution`
6. Removed unused `calculatePromptAttributionForSave` function and `getFileContentFromTree` helper
7. Removed all debug logging statements

**How it works now**:
- When `UserPromptSubmit` fires → `InitializeSession` calculates attribution by diffing worktree vs last checkpoint
- At this moment, the agent hasn't run yet, so ALL differences are user edits (no filtering needed)
- Attribution is stored as `PendingPromptAttribution` in session state
- When `SaveChanges` is called → uses the pending attribution and clears it

    18→// Only counts lines that actually changed in the commit, not total file sizes.

    23→	checkpointTree *object.Tree,
    24→	committedTree *object.Tree,

    98→// getFileContent retrieves the content of a file from a tree.
    99→// Returns empty string if the file doesn't exist or can't be read.
   100→func getFileContent(tree *object.Tree, path string) string {
   101→	if tree == nil {
   102→		return ""
   103→	}
   104→
   105→	file, err := tree.File(path)
   106→	if err != nil {
   107→		return ""
   108→	}
   109→
   110→	content, err := file.Contents()
   111→	if err != nil {
   112→		return ""
   113→	}
   114→
   115→	// Skip binary files (contain null bytes)
   116→	if strings.Contains(content, "\x00") {
   117→		return ""
   118→	}
   119→
   120→	return content
   121→}
   122→
   123→// diffLines compares two strings and returns line-level diff stats.
   124→// Returns (unchanged, added, removed) line counts.
   125→func diffLines(checkpointContent, committedContent string) (unchanged, added, removed int) {
   126→	// Handle edge cases
   127→	if checkpointContent == committedContent {
   128→		return countLinesStr(committedContent), 0, 0
   129→	}
   130→	if checkpointContent == "" {
   131→		return 0, countLinesStr(committedContent), 0
   132→	}
   133→	if committedContent == "" {
   134→		return 0, 0, countLinesStr(checkpointContent)
   135→	}
   136→
   137→	dmp := diffmatchpatch.New()
   138→
   139→	// Convert to line-based diff using DiffLinesToChars/DiffCharsToLines pattern
   140→	text1, text2, lineArray := dmp.DiffLinesToChars(checkpointContent, committedContent)
   141→	diffs := dmp.DiffMain(text1, text2, false)
   142→	diffs = dmp.DiffCharsToLines(diffs, lineArray)
   143→
   144→	for _, d := range diffs {
   145→		lines := countLinesInText(d.Text)
   146→		switch d.Type {
   147→		case diffmatchpatch.DiffEqual:
   148→			unchanged += lines
   149→		case diffmatchpatch.DiffInsert:
   150→			added += lines
   151→		case diffmatchpatch.DiffDelete:
   152→			removed += lines
   153→		}
   154→	}
   155→
   156→	return unchanged, added, removed
   157→}
   158→
   159→// countLinesStr returns the number of lines in content string.
   160→// An empty string has 0 lines. A string without newlines has 1 line.
   161→func countLinesStr(content string) int {
   162→	if content == "" {
   163→		return 0
   164→	}
   165→	lines := strings.Count(content, "\n")
   166→	// If content doesn't end with newline, add 1 for the last line
   167→	if !strings.HasSuffix(content, "\n") {
   168→		lines++
   169→	}
   170→	return lines
   171→}
   172→
   173→// countLinesInText counts lines in a diff text segment.
   174→// Similar to countLines but handles the diff output format.
   175→func countLinesInText(text string) int {
   176→	if text == "" {
   177→		return 0
   178→	}
   179→	// Count newlines as line separators
   180→	lines := strings.Count(text, "\n")
   181→	// If text doesn't end with newline and is not empty, count the last line
   182→	if !strings.HasSuffix(text, "\n") && len(text) > 0 {
   183→		lines++
   184→	}
   185→	return lines
   186→}
   187→
   188→// CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated computes final attribution using accumulated prompt data.
   189→// This provides more accurate attribution than tree-only comparison because it captures
   190→// user edits that happened between checkpoints (which would otherwise be mixed into the
   191→// checkpoint snapshots).
   192→//
   193→// The calculation:
   194→// 1. Sum user edits from PromptAttributions (captured at each prompt start)
   195→// 2. Add user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head diff)
   196→// 3. Calculate agent lines from base → shadow
   197→// 4. Compute percentages
   198→func CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated(
   199→	baseTree *object.Tree,
   200→	shadowTree *object.Tree,
   201→	headTree *object.Tree,
   202→	filesTouched []string,
   203→	promptAttributions []PromptAttribution,
   204→) *checkpoint.InitialAttribution {
   205→	if len(filesTouched) == 0 {
   206→		return nil
   207→	}
   208→
   209→	// Sum accumulated user lines from prompt attributions
   210→	var accumulatedUserAdded, accumulatedUserRemoved int
   211→	for _, pa := range promptAttributions {
   212→		accumulatedUserAdded += pa.UserLinesAdded
   213→		accumulatedUserRemoved += pa.UserLinesRemoved
   214→	}
   215→
   216→	// Calculate user edits AFTER the final checkpoint (shadow → head)
   217→	// These are edits the user made after the last agent checkpoint
   218→	var postCheckpointUserAdded, postCheckpointUserRemoved int
   219→	var totalAgentAdded, totalAgentRemoved int
   220→
   221→	for _, filePath := range filesTouched {
   222→		baseContent := getFileContent(baseTree, filePath)
   223→		shadowContent := getFileContent(shadowTree, filePath)
   224→		headContent := getFileContent(headTree, filePath)
   225→
   226→		// Agent contribution: base → shadow
   227→		_, agentAdded, agentRemoved := diffLines(baseContent, shadowContent)
   228→		totalAgentAdded += agentAdded
   229→		totalAgentRemoved += agentRemoved
   230→
   231→		// Post-checkpoint user edits: shadow → head
   232→		_, postUserAdded, postUserRemoved := diffLines(shadowContent, headContent)
   233→		postCheckpointUserAdded += postUserAdded
   234→		postCheckpointUserRemoved += postUserRemoved
   235→	}
   236→
   237→	// Total user contribution = accumulated (between checkpoints) + post-checkpoint
   238→	totalUserAdded := accumulatedUserAdded + postCheckpointUserAdded
   239→	totalUserRemoved := accumulatedUserRemoved + postCheckpointUserRemoved
   240→
   241→	// Estimate modified lines (user changed existing agent lines)
   242→	humanModified := min(totalUserAdded, totalUserRemoved)
   243→	pureUserAdded := totalUserAdded - humanModified
   244→	pureUserRemoved := totalUserRemoved - humanModified
   245→
   246→	// Total lines in commit = agent added + user added (net new lines)
   247→	totalCommitted := totalAgentAdded + pureUserAdded
   248→	if totalCommitted == 0 {
   249→		totalCommitted = totalAgentAdded // Fallback for delete-only
   250→	}
   251→
   252→	// Calculate percentage
   253→	var agentPercentage float64
   254→	if totalCommitted > 0 {
   255→		agentPercentage = float64(totalAgentAdded) / float64(totalCommitted) * 100
   256→	}
   257→
   258→	return &checkpoint.InitialAttribution{
   259→		CalculatedAt:    time.Now(),
   260→		AgentLines:      totalAgentAdded,
   261→		HumanAdded:      pureUserAdded,
   262→		HumanModified:   humanModified,
   263→		HumanRemoved:    pureUserRemoved,
   264→		TotalCommitted:  totalCommitted,
   265→		AgentPercentage: agentPercentage,
   266→	}
   267→}
   268→
   269→// CalculatePromptAttribution computes line-level attribution at the start of a prompt.
   270→// This captures user edits since the last checkpoint BEFORE the agent makes changes.
   271→//
   272→// Parameters:
   273→//   - baseTree: the tree at session start (the base commit)
   274→//   - lastCheckpointTree: the tree from the previous checkpoint (nil if first checkpoint)
   275→//   - worktreeFiles: map of file path → current worktree content for files that changed
   276→//   - checkpointNumber: which checkpoint we're about to create (1-indexed)
   277→//
   278→// Returns the attribution data to store in session state.
   279→func CalculatePromptAttribution(
   280→	baseTree *object.Tree,
   281→	lastCheckpointTree *object.Tree,
   282→	worktreeFiles map[string]string,
   283→	checkpointNumber int,
   284→) PromptAttribution {
   285→	result := PromptAttribution{
   286→		CheckpointNumber: checkpointNumber,
   287→	}
   288→
   289→	if len(worktreeFiles) == 0 {
   290→		return result
   291→	}
   292→
   293→	// Determine reference tree for user changes (last checkpoint or base)
   294→	referenceTree := lastCheckpointTree
   295→	if referenceTree == nil {
   296→		referenceTree = baseTree
   297→	}
   298→
   299→	for filePath, worktreeContent := range worktreeFiles {
   300→		referenceContent := getFileContent(referenceTree, filePath)
   301→		baseContent := getFileContent(baseTree, filePath)
   302→
   303→		// User changes: diff(reference, worktree)
   304→		// These are changes since the last checkpoint that the agent didn't make
   305→		_, userAdded, userRemoved := diffLines(referenceContent, worktreeContent)
   306→		result.UserLinesAdded += userAdded
   307→		result.UserLinesRemoved += userRemoved
   308→
   309→		// Agent lines so far: diff(base, lastCheckpoint)
   310→		// Only calculate if we have a previous checkpoint
   311→		if lastCheckpointTree != nil {
   312→			checkpointContent := getFileContent(lastCheckpointTree, filePath)
   313→			_, agentAdded, agentRemoved := diffLines(baseContent, checkpointContent)
   314→			result.AgentLinesAdded += agentAdded
   315→			result.AgentLinesRemoved += agentRemoved
   316→		}
   317→	}
   318→
   319→	return result
   320→}
